summary: Karman Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K to report a Fifth Amendment to its Credit Agreement dated August 3, 2026. The amendment refinances $763.961 million of existing term loans, reducing the interest rate by 50 basis points to SOFR plus 2.25%, and cuts the revolving credit facility pricing grid by 50 basis points per leverage level, max SOFR plus 2.00%. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No terms disclosed beyond the rates; no board recommendation, advisors, or structural changes. What to watch: potential interest expense savings; no risk-arb angle.
